name: West Side Scuba Centre
summary: A family-run PADI dive shop at the Boatyard Beach Club on Carlisle Bay, started in 1993 by Peter Grannum and now run with his son Brandon. Small boats go to more than 20 wreck and reef sites on the south and west coasts, 10 to 20 minutes away, with courses from a first try to Dive Master.
standouts: Never more than 12 people on the boat, Discover Scuba limited to 4 per instructor
No anchors dropped: mooring buoys or free descents only

contact.address: Boatyard Beach Club, 3 Bay Street, Bridgetown, Barbados

trips.title: Two Tank Morning Dive

highlights: Sites chosen by conditions and experience
Dock boarding at the Boatyard Beach Club
Never more than 12 people on the boat

checkNotes: Prices are shown in both US$ and BDS$ on the price list; both recorded. Payment is cash only in the shop; a credit card is taken to hold bookings and cancellations with less than 48 hours notice are charged in full. Online booking is a PADI Travel iframe (travel.padi.com widget for shop west-side-scuba-centre) on the operator's own Book Online page; the widget itself was not opened. Diving page says trips run six days a week, while the contact page lists the shop open 7:30am to 4:30pm every day. Rental extras: wetsuit US$10, dive computer US$20, GoPro and housing US$30. Transport to the shop can be arranged, price varies by location. Events page lists PADI Women's Dive Day and Barbados Dive Fest 2026 (both past) and a dive show in November 2026.
